updates.note: Management reiterated EBITDA margin expectation of 26%-27% without interest income.
updates.quote: Yes, without interest income it should be somewhere around 26%-27%

updates.note: ROH revenue growth expectation revised down to 8% to 9%.
updates.quote: ROH, we expect the growth to be consistent in line with the past and it should be somewhere between 8% to 9% growth should be there in ROH activities.
With the current visibility of orders, we will have our workload full for 2032 and we can consistently maintain this double-digit growth without any problem.

updates.note: Reiterated start of HTT-40 deliveries from September 2025 onwards.
updates.quote: So HTT-40 will start commencement of deliveries from September ‘25 onward.

updates.note: Reiterated that Sukhoi engine contract is in advanced stages to be finalized in 1-2 months.
updates.quote: We expect the orders to get materialized in the next 1 to 2 months timeframe it should happen

new_promises.statement: Estimate total capex for the next 5 years to be between 14,000 to 15,000 crores.
new_promises.quote: So, the CAPEX plan for the next 5 years is estimated to be somewhere between 14,000 to 15,000 crores
new_promises.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

new_promises.statement: Bring down manpower cost to 16% of revenue in the current financial year.
new_promises.quote: we expected to bring it down to further to 16% of revenue in the current financial year.
new_promises.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

new_promises.statement: Conclude the contract for the 97 LCA Mark 1A aircraft before 31st March 2025.
new_promises.quote: I think we should be in a position to conclude the contract by the current financial year that is before the 31st March ‘25.
new_promises.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

new_promises.statement: Achieve 3-year revenue mix of 60% ROH activity and 40% manufacturing activity.
new_promises.quote: Mix will be probably in the ratio of 60 to 40. 60 will be the ROH activity, 40 should be the manufacturing activity.
new_promises.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan
